d: 234 appearances, 146 goals, a European Championship and two UEFA Nations League titles. Cristiano Ronaldo leaves behind an extraordinary legacy with Portugal, but his international retirement has arrived in circumstances few would have expected. At 41, the Al Nassr superstar is walking away from the national team without the grand farewell many imagined. Rupha Ramani dives deep in Ronaldo's final chapter with Portugal, his World Cup heartbreak, the Jorge Jesus controversy and what the end of his international career means for Portuguese football.
